entry.title: OpenGCUA: Toward a Fully Open Stack for Generalist Computer Use
entry.summary: Introduces an open generalist computer-use stack combining visual and programmatic interaction, with model-controlled observation and task-state decisions.

entry.title: OS-Helix: Unifying GUI Interaction and Code Execution in Native Computer-Using Agents
entry.summary: Trains native computer-use models to coordinate GUI actions and code execution using hybrid demonstrations and online reinforcement learning.

entry.title: LEASH: Uncertainty-Aware Weak-to-Strong Escalation and Oversight for Computer-Use Agents
entry.summary: Uses weak-agent uncertainty to decide when to escalate to a stronger model and monitor its subsequent task execution.

entry.title: MAI-Gym: An Open All-in-One Platform for GUI Agent Evaluation and RL Training across Mobile and Computer Environments
entry.summary: Unifies GUI evaluation, trajectory collection, environment synthesis, and online reinforcement learning across mobile, computer, and web tasks.

entry.title: Work2Skill: Capturing Human GUI Experience for Reusable Agent Skill Induction
entry.summary: Aligns human screen recordings, input events, and accessibility information to derive reusable workflow skills from desktop demonstrations.

entry.title: MedImageOSWorld: Benchmarking GUI Agents for Medical Image Consoles
entry.summary: Evaluates GUI agents in simulated medical-imaging consoles, separately checking workflow completion and acquisition outcomes against hidden anatomical targets.

entry.title: Control OSWorld: An AI Control Environment for GUI Computer Use Agents
entry.summary: Pairs OSWorld tasks with harmful side objectives to evaluate monitors that detect malicious behavior in computer-use agent trajectories.

entry.title: GUI-HARVEST: Self-Improving GUI Agents through Evidence-Driven Harness Evolution
entry.summary: Improves GUI-agent execution code by analyzing action effects and repeated-task failures, then validating bounded changes with frozen model weights.

entry.title: DeskForge: Dense Supervision from Desktop Environments for Computer-Use Agents
entry.summary: Generates dense desktop supervision by varying real application scenes and combining screenshots, accessibility trees, and window geometry.

entry.title: OSWorld-Science: A Benchmark of Computer Use Agents for Learning and Using Scientific Software
entry.summary: Benchmarks computer agents on scientific-software workflows with task-specific checks of application states and generated research artifacts.

entry.title: cua-speedrun: Standardized Benchmarking of the Speed of Computer-Use Agents
entry.summary: Standardizes virtual machines, interaction pipelines, and agent interfaces to compare computer-use speed, cost, and task performance.

entry.title: EngiWorld: What Can Frontier Agents Deliver in Professional Engineering Environments?
entry.summary: Introduces professional engineering tasks across software domains, with GUI and CLI access and artifact checks for geometric, physical, and design validity.

entry.title: HybridCUA: Learning to Orchestrate GUI and CLI for Computer-Use Agents
entry.summary: Trains computer agents on verified GUI, command-line, and interleaved trajectories to learn when and how to combine interaction modes.

entry.title: WebPageBench: Event-Level Verification and Controlled UI-Variant Generation for Web Agents
entry.summary: Verifies web tasks through typed interface events and generates controlled UI variations while preserving instructions and success conditions.

entry.title: DashAct: A Progressive Diagnostic Benchmark for GUI Agents in Interactive Dashboard Analysis
entry.summary: Diagnoses dashboard-agent failures by progressively restoring interaction context, next-action support, and visual target information within the same task.

entry.title: ScreenHaystack: Finding Blind Zones in GUI Grounding
entry.summary: Moves controlled target icons across high-resolution interfaces to diagnose spatial blind zones in grounding models and study targeted augmentation.

entry.title: Jev-Mobile: Jev as an Executor for Mobile GUI Agents
entry.summary: Separates occasional visual-language planning from frequent lightweight action selection over an accessibility-tree-based action space.

entry.title: OSWorld-Pro: Process-based Evaluation for Computer Use Agents
entry.summary: Adds annotated intermediate subgoals to computer-use tasks and uses process-oriented evaluation to identify action and progress failures.

entry.title: BlueLM-GUI Technical Report: A Real-Device-Centric Flywheel for Self-Improving Mobile GUI Agents
entry.summary: Describes a mobile-agent training pipeline centered on real-device rollouts, recovery of useful supervision from failures, and evolving evaluation tasks.

entry.title: APPSim-Bench: Bridging Real-world Apps and Reproducible Evaluation for Mobile GUI Agents
entry.summary: Introduces controlled simulated mobile apps with deterministic backend data and outcome checks for reproducible evaluation of realistic interactions.

entry.title: CUA-Universe: A Scalable and Dynamic Environment for Hybrid GUI+CLI Agents
entry.summary: Turns desktop applications into reproducible GUI-and-CLI environments and generates verified hybrid trajectories for agent post-training.

entry.title: Efficient GUI Agents: A Systems Survey of Observation, Memory, Action, and Runtime Optimization
entry.summary: Survey of research directions in GUI or computer-use agents.

entry.title: WM-R1: Training GUI Agents to Reason and leverage World Models with Reinforcement Learning
entry.summary: Uses learned world models for mobile-agent training rollouts and for reasoning about the consequences of candidate GUI actions.

entry.title: ADeptS-Bench: Measuring the Trustworthiness of Computer Use Agents Across Devices
entry.summary: Evaluates interface-embedded threats and whether computer-use agents seek clarification when mobile or desktop instructions are ambiguous.

entry.title: Training Needs Trustworthy Worlds: Verified Synthetic Web Environments for Agent Learning
entry.summary: Builds synthetic websites with verified navigation, backend state, and feasible tasks to provide reliable supervision for web-agent training.

entry.title: Wuying-Browser-Agent: Real-World Centric Fundamental Long-Horizon Browser Agents
entry.summary: Combines a browser execution framework, recovery-oriented supervision, and online reinforcement learning, with a bilingual live-web task benchmark.

entry.title: MobileWorldSafety: Benchmarking GUI Agent Safety Against Environmental Injection Attacks in Android Apps
entry.summary: Evaluates environmental injection risks in Android tasks using programmatic risk checks and model-based adjudication of ambiguous cases.

entry.title: UI-Mate: Advancing Open-Weight Foundation GUI Agents with In-Context Demonstrations
entry.summary: Combines environment-grounded training with demonstration-conditioned workflows, and introduces OSWorkerBench for extended office-task evaluation.

entry.title: RealGUINoise: An Interactive Cross-Platform Benchmark for GUI Agent Robustness under Real-World Interface Noise
entry.summary: Evaluates interactive GUI agents under varied realistic interface noise, comparing task completion, safety, and behavior with clean-environment runs.

entry.title: Qwen-UI-Agent Technical Report: Toward Next-Generation Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents
entry.summary: Describes a foundation GUI agent with combined GUI and command-line actions, large-scale interaction infrastructure, and iterative environment and task generation.

entry.title: SeerGuard: A Safety Framework for Mobile GUI Agents via World Model Prediction
entry.summary: Uses instruction screening and a safety-augmented world model to assess likely consequences of mobile GUI actions before execution.

entry.title: HyMobileAgent: Data-Environment Co-Scaling for Efficient GUI Agents
entry.summary: Combines GUI perception data, instructional videos, real and simulated devices, and planning with reflection to develop a mobile agent.

entry.title: Xiaomi-GUI-0 Technical Report
entry.summary: Describes a mobile GUI agent trained through real-device interaction, corrected failure trajectories, supervised learning, and reinforcement learning.

entry.title: OSWorld 2.0: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents on Long-Horizon Real-World Tasks
entry.summary: Introduces extended computer-use workflows with realistic artifacts, changing information, hidden state, and partial-progress and safety assessments.

entry.title: MacAgentBench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Real-World macOS Desktop
entry.summary: Introduces macOS tasks spanning GUI and command-line interaction, with deterministic checks and intermediate-progress scoring for application workflows.

entry.title: OSGuard: A Benchmark for Safety in Computer-Use Agents
entry.summary: Evaluates action-level guardrails and full computer tasks with environment-dependent safety constraints, separating safe completion from nominal success.

entry.title: iOSWorld: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Phone Agents
entry.summary: Introduces a native iOS simulator benchmark with persistent user data, multi-app tasks, and personalization-dependent phone workflows.

entry.title: GoClick: Lightweight Element Grounding Model for Autonomous GUI Interaction
entry.summary: Studies a compact encoder-decoder grounding model and progressive training-data refinement for resource-constrained GUI interaction.

entry.title: MedSPOT: A Workflow-Aware Sequential Grounding Benchmark for Clinical GUI
entry.summary: Benchmarks sequential target localization in clinical software workflows, emphasizing how early mistakes affect subsequent interaction steps.

entry.title: Mobile-Agent-v3.5: Multi-platform Fundamental GUI Agents
entry.summary: Presents GUI-Owl-1.5 variants and a hybrid data pipeline for multimodal GUI interaction, tool use, memory, and multi-platform tasks.

entry.title: MobileWorld: Benchmarking Autonomous Mobile Agents in Agent-User Interactive and MCP-Augmented Environments
entry.summary: Introduces long mobile workflows that combine agent-user interaction, cross-application tasks, and MCP-based tool access.

entry.title: MobileWorldBench: Towards Semantic World Modeling For Mobile Agents
entry.summary: Evaluates semantic world models for mobile interfaces and studies natural-language state transitions as a tool for agent planning.

entry.title: GUI-360$^\circ$: A Comprehensive Dataset and Benchmark for Computer-Using Agents
entry.summary: Collects Windows application trajectories with screenshots and action traces for grounding, screen parsing, and action prediction.

entry.title: VideoAgentTrek: Computer Use Pretraining from Unlabeled Videos
entry.summary: Extracts structured GUI actions from screen-recorded tutorials using inverse dynamics, then uses the inferred trajectories for computer-use training.

entry.title: AppAgent-Pro: A Proactive GUI Agent System for Multidomain Information Integration and User Assistance
entry.summary: Proposes a proactive GUI assistant that gathers information across domains in response to user requests and anticipated information needs.

entry.title: Mobile-Agent-v3: Fundamental Agents for GUI Automation
entry.summary: Introduces GUI-Owl models and Mobile-Agent-v3 orchestration, using environment-generated trajectories to support GUI capabilities.

entry.title: ComputerRL: Scaling End-to-End Online Reinforcement Learning for Computer Use Agents
entry.summary: Combines API and GUI actions with distributed desktop reinforcement learning and alternating supervised training to address training instability.

entry.title: UI-Venus Technical Report: Building High-performance UI Agents with RFT
entry.summary: Studies screenshot-based GUI grounding and navigation using curated interaction data, reward design, and reinforcement fine-tuning.

entry.title: OpenCUA: Open Foundations for Computer-Use Agents
entry.summary: Presents demonstration collection infrastructure, the AgentNet dataset, and a training pipeline for open computer-use models.

entry.title: InfiGUI-G1: Advancing GUI Grounding with Adaptive Exploration Policy Optimization
entry.summary: Uses multiple candidate answers and adaptive exploration rewards to improve spatial and semantic alignment in GUI grounding.
